issueSummary: The repaired inference topology now closes both original false-clean paths and the emitted-export variants found during rereview. Runtime classification resolves exported symbols back to same-file emitted declarations, including call-initialized values, namespaces, uninitialized variables, local named/default exports, and destructured bindings, while ambient declarations and cross-file barrels remain non-runtime. Suite coverage requires static import/re-export reachability from the governed subsystem test roots, so an empty suite path or category alone covers nothing. The real tree publishes 112 source files and 49 test files, classified as exact=34, suite=69, non-runtime=9, uncovered=0 with no findings, alarms, tool errors, or withheld owner. The governing docs and catalog now describe that implemented contract.

resolvedFindings.originalFailure: Exported call initializers and other emitted exports could enter the non-runtime bucket.
resolvedFindings.repair: tooling/src/verify/gates/test-presence-inference.ts resolves export symbols to same-file emitted declarations and excludes only ambient declarations and cross-file barrels.
independentEvidence: Production runPolicyPass reported one blocking finding for each untested emitted form: exported call initializer, namespace, uninitialized variable, local named export, local default export, and destructured local export.
The ambient declare namespace/variable witness and cross-file re-export barrel produced zero findings and non-runtime=1.
The exact-module mirror witness produced zero findings and exact=1.

resolvedFindings.originalFailure: A named but empty suite file covered every runtime source under its category prefix.
resolvedFindings.repair: Suite topology names governed test roots, then traverses resolved static import and re-export edges; a source is suite-covered only when the relevant test-root graph reaches it.
independentEvidence: An empty tests/inference/conformance/applicability.suite.test.ts plus an arbitrary exported backend function produced one blocking finding and suite=0.
The healthy witness importing a backend barrel that re-exported the runtime module produced zero findings and suite=1.
The family test independently pins both directions through the production policy pass.

resolvedFindings.originalFailure: The governing docs still described exported data as non-runtime and the old @inference-only population after the structural repair.
resolvedFindings.repair: ab02d359c updates Spine-Testing and the active-gates row to state emitted-export classification, structural suite reachability, and the combined bounded inference/test population; catalog hashes and receipts were regenerated.
independentEvidence: docs/architecture/core/Spine-Testing.md:136-146 now matches the runtime classifier and suite graph.
docs/architecture/core/Core-Enforcement-Active-Gates.md:148 names the exact population and resource contract.
docs/catalog/catalog.json and docs/catalog/receipts/architecture-core.json parse successfully and carry the current document hashes.
